description: We are Vallesyn, explorers driven by a passion for space, fuelled by curiosity and creativity. “We want to make sense of NASA’s Mars data so we can explore more safely and intelligently.” We aim to build an integrated Mars mapping and mission planning tool using technology, science and innovation. We’re looking for teammates who are excited and possess skills in coding, UI/UX, data analysis, GIS, or scientific research and are ready to explore the unknown with us.
